Initialization requirement satisfied by setting PWM channels D2/D3/D4 to 0 so RGB LED is off after reset.

Color-cycling behavior (RED->GREEN->BLUE->OFF repeating each press) is implemented in SysML using the button press event; PWM scaling (e.g., full intensity value) is left as a model decision since brightness value is not specified in the prompt.
No serial requirements were provided, so no serial channels are configured.

configuration_resolution.original_requirement:
Target board is Arduino Mega 2560 as specified in the supplied circuit; use this board when the prose says UNO.

**Task**:
You are tasked with programming an Arduino (uno) to control an RGB LED (rgb1) using a push button (k1).

**Detail Rules**:
Initialization: Upon powering on or resetting, the RGB LED should be off.
Button Interaction: Each press of the button (k1) should cycle the RGB LED through a sequence of colors:
First Press: LED displays red.
Second Press: LED displays green.
Third Press: LED displays blue.
Fourth Press: LED turns off.
This sequence should repeat with each subsequent press of the button.
